Under guide 3.6 'none' requires no retraction, expression-of-concern or retraction-type vocabulary in the rendered footnote, and 'Erratum' is named in 3.6 as correction vocabulary. It is not a retraction or expression of concern, so 'warning' does not apply. The guide gives no category for an erratum attached to the cited work; its own example (erratum in a note) is 'ambiguous', so that is the label. Guide 1.0 ambiguity: the template ties the erratum to this work, but guide 1.1 has no 'correction' label, so 'ambiguous' is the closest reading that follows the wording. The engine's 'ambiguous' agrees with this reading; that agreement is not the basis of the decision.
